notes.title: One version
notes.content:
Your suggestions matter for us!

We are removing free to play rules from the Abrix Steam version. Since now, all Abrix games will all be Diamond package which include:
- All available levels
- All bonuses and level boosters for free (they can be purchased for 0 lollipops)
- No in-game payments

And all for one flat and extermely low price: 1.99$ !

notes.title: Abrix 2
notes.content:
We introduce new huge update. Abrix 2.

Now with completely new graphics and new features. Try it even if you didn't like the old game.

Changes:
[list]
[*] New graphics, all in 2D - no more isometric view.
[*] New bonuses like replicator, bubble and wildcard spawner.
[*] New in-game currency: lollipops.
[*] No more time limit, now there's a steps limit.
[*] No more gnomes, you didn't like them :)
[*] Best levels from old version and many new levels, now 170 levels and more in the future.
[*] Boosters on level start that help you to finish it.
[*] Limited lives. If you die 5 times, you need to cool down and wait a little.
[*] Gifts every 10 levels with extra boosters and lollipops.
[*] Saves not only in a Steam Cloud but also in our wide cloud that enable you to continue playing in HTML 5 version of Abrix or on Android version (in the future)
[/list]
Old save files are not compatible with new version.

During game development we used many of your suggestions to make it better: no more obscured isometric view, bad animations, time limit and many others. If you have more suggestions: let's discuss them on the community pages.
Or: make a review of the game - we read all your reviews.

notes.title: Abrix is changing!
notes.content:
Abrix 2 is coming! 
In a few days we will release a huge upgrade. 

What will happen with the current products:

- Abrix the robot, Abrix for kids and Adventures of Abrix will be still available for all owners with special bonuses granted to all players who supported us. 

- DLC's: Abrix the robot - rooms with bombs DLC and Abrix the robot - rooms with lasers DLC  will be removed from the store. All these rooms will be included in the main game after the update.

- DLC: Abrix the robot - bonus soundtrack DLC - will be still available in the store

- Demo to Abrix the robot will be removed from the store, but free version will be soon released in the store as free to play.

- Workshop will be discontinued.

Stay with us for more news.

notes.title: Play Lemuria: Lost in Space - unique sci-fi adventure full of mysteries and puzzles.
Play Lemuria: Lost in Space - unique sci-fi adventure full of mysteries and puzzles.
Update 1.2.25 with controller support!
notes.content:
New 1.2.25 update contains full controller support with Steam Controller native support. Level editor is not supported. The game now also supports other controllers supported by Steam Link and generic controllers. If you found anu bug, please report it to us (please report controller model).
1.2.25 contains also:
- fixed bug that not allowed to play with arrows keys
- fixed some other small bugs
